<subject>URGENT - REQUIRES IMMEDIATE ACTION - Nordwind Energie AG Orientation tomorrow @Hotel Atlantic</subject>
<body>
Date: Donnerstag, 23. Januar 2025

Location: Hotel Atlantic

Orientation will be split into two sessions and divided by alpha-order. Sessions will run 10am-1pm and 2pm-5pm.

We encourage all of you to attend your designated session as valuable information will be presented, and you will have the opportunity to get answers to your questions.

You will need to bring your Nordwind Energie AG ID card or Personalausweis.

You can speed things up tomorrow by filling in the attached forms - alternatively you can complete them there tomorrow

10am Session   Letters A- K

2pm Session Letters L-Z


Registration will be outside of the Kastanien Room.

Bus Transportation

Buses will depart from the Behrensbogen area on the ground floor of the north building at:

First session 				Second session
8:45am-9am				12:45pm-1pm
